title: CS_SETSPAWN
description: A simple and powerful Minecraft plugin that allows players to set and teleport to custom spawn points easily.
body:
Description:
cs_setspawn v3.1 is a stylish and fully customizable Minecraft plugin that upgrades your spawn system with color, sound, and smooth visuals. It brings life to simple commands like /setspawn and /reload using mini-font titles, deep colors, and clean effects.

✨ Main Features:

🟩 Customizable About Bar (can switch to Title Bar or Boss Bar)

🔊 Plays premium sound effects on every command action

💬 /setspawn shows a beautiful Title Bar message

🔁 In-game reload via /csreload or /cs_setspawn reload

🎨 Full color code support (§ and & supported)

⚙️ All messages & sounds configurable in config.yml

🧩 Console message: # cs_setspawn v3.1 plugin loaded successfully!


🧱 Perfect for servers like BoxPvP, Lifestyle, or PvP-based modes — lightweight, customizable, and built for professionals.
